//: NOTE, 2026-08-10: the deployed service does not read this file. Dashboard settings override it, and its builder is RAILPACK rather than the NIXPACKS declared below. Its pre-deploy command was `npm run db:seed:deploy` — seeding but never migrating — which caused five consecutive failed deploys: the seed ran a Prisma client aware of new columns against a database no migration had touched, and died with P2022 before the server started. It has since been corrected to `npm run db:deploy && npm run db:constraints`. Two things learned the hard way: Railway's redeploy replays the previous snapshot, so a config change only takes effect on the next real deployment; and seeding must never gate a deploy, because demo data failing to load is not a reason to refuse to serve. Keep this file in step with the dashboard or delete it — a config describing behaviour that does not happen is worse than none. See the Deploying section of README.md.

build.//: No npm ci here. Nixpacks installs dependencies in an earlier layer and mounts a build cache at node_modules/.cache; a second npm ci tries to remove node_modules and fails with EBUSY on that mount.
build.buildCommand: npm run db:generate && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:constraints && npm start
